notes: *it* at t009 taken as an added supplied object; the competing reading folds it into the infinitive, which rule 44 forbids where no object morpheme stands in the clause.
The opening waw takes *therefore* off the ASV's own connective list (rule 14), the unit discontinuous around the fronted imperative (rule 25).
אֶרֶץ takes the supplied *in* and *a* as an adverbial accusative (rules 33, 15); חָלָב takes the construct relation recast as *with* (rule 19).
